title: torch.compile regression in 2.8.0
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug Hi there, I've been a fan of `torch.compile` as it helped to speed up my code substantially in most cases. However, some of it broke in 2.8.0. For instance, I have this pure PyTorch implementation of an LLM that is geared towards code readability, which got an ~2x speed-up on CPU and ~4x speed-up on GPU when compiled in PyTorch 2.6 and 2.7.1 Now, in 2.8.0, this no longer works as the compilations errors with: ```python /Users/sebastian/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/_refs/__init__.py:5767: UserWarning: record_context_cpp is not support on non-linux non-x86_64 platforms (Triggered internally at /Users/runner/work/pytorch/pytorch/pytorch/torch/csrc/profiler/unwind/unwind.cpp:12.) r = torch.where(mask, value, a) # type: ignore[arg-type] W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] torch._dynamo hit config.recompile_limit (8) W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] function: 'forward' (/Users/sebastian/Desktop/qwen3.py:57) W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] last reason: 0/7: tensor 'cache.cache[0][0]' size mismatch at index 2. expected 77, actual 78 W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] To log all recompilation reasons, use TORCH_LOGS="recompiles". W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] To diagnose recompilation issues, see https://pytorch.org/docs/main/torch.compiler_troubleshooting.html. ``` Sure, the code is not particularly optimized for compilation (like I mentioned above, it's geared towards readability for educational purposes and hackability), but it did work fine in 2.6 and 2.7.1, which is why I think this is a regression. CCing @mlazos (with whom I briefly discussed the issue) I uploaded a reproducible, self-contained code example here: https://github.com/rasbt/bugreport/tree/master/pytorch/torch_compile_qwen3 ### Error logs ```python /Users/sebastian/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/_refs/__init__.py:5767: UserWarning: record_context_cpp is not support on non-linux non-x86_64 platforms (Triggered internally at /Users/runner/work/pytorch/pytorch/pytorch/torch/csrc/profiler/unwind/unwind.cpp:12.) r = torch.where(mask, value, a) # type: ignore[arg-type] W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] torch._dynamo hit config.recompile_limit (8) W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] function: 'forward' (/Users/sebastian/Desktop/qwen3.py:57) W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] last reason: 0/7: tensor 'cache.cache[0][0]' size mismatch at index 2. expected 77, actual 78 W0823 18:56:31.554000 40177 torch/_dynamo/convert_frame.py:1016] [0/8] To log all recompilation reasons, use TORCH_LOGS="recompiles". error_description: torch.compile worked fine in PyTorch 2.6 and 2.7.1, providing ~2x speed-up on CPU and ~4x speed-up on GPU for an LLM implementation. In 2.8.0, compilation fails with torch._dynamo hitting config.recompile_limit (8) and tensor 'cache.cache[0][0]' size mismatch at index 2 (expected 77, actual 78).
